Quantitative researcher specializing in statistical modeling, forecasting, data products, and research engineering.
Experienced in building end-to-end analytical workflows that transform raw data into models, analytical tools, and production-ready research outputs.







Senior Economic Analyst - Data Science & Modeling Lead


São Paulo, Brazil · 2022 - Present



Lead the Data Science and Modeling team within the Macroeconomic Research department, providing technical leadership and advancing the use of modern data and analytical technologies across research workflows.
Develop quantitative models and forecasting systems for macroeconomic analysis.
Build and maintain production analytical infrastructure, including data pipelines, automated reporting, and internal research applications.






Quantitative Research Analyst


São Paulo, Brazil · 2019 - 2022



Developed quantitative models and forecasting tools for macroeconomic and financial analysis.
Integrated alternative datasets into investment research workflows.






Economic Research Analyst


Brasília, Brazil · 2017 - 2019



Conducted regional economic analysis and monitoring of economic activity indicators.
Produced reports and studies supporting public policy discussions and decision-making.
Developed statistical indicators and analytical tools for economic assessment.





M.S. in Economics, Universidade Federal Fluminense · 2017
B.S. in Economics, Universidade Federal Fluminense · 2013



Author of R for Economic Research, a practical guide to data analysis, statistical modeling, and forecasting for applied research.

title: CV

2020 – Present · São Paulo, Brazil
